stages.review: 出てきたものを確かめる場面

purpose: Identify distinctive, evidence-backed combinations of human choices in AI collaboration that a reader can understand without knowing the project. Distinctive means a specific choice structure in this sample, not rarity among people, superiority, a stable trait or a proven reusable technique.
rules: Review every selected excerpt. One case at most per excerpt; insufficient context is a valid result. Do not fill a quota.
Ground situation, human_action and ai_role independently with message refs. human_action references must be human messages. Describe a request as a request, never as completed execution.

Use response.status not_visible with empty refs, assistant_report with later assistant refs, or user_report with later human refs. Self-report is not independently verified effectiveness. A request to commit is not a claim that a design worked.

Keep corrections tied to the actual task stage and AI response. Do not turn AI mistakes into the person's universal habits. If the triggering answer or image is missing, describe that limit rather than reconstructing it.

limitation names missing context, outcome or transfer conditions. question is a specific question for the person, not a generic dimension prompt. try_next is a hypothetical request template, clearly separate from observed evidence; do not promise success.
Anonymize all prose: no raw quotes, names, paths, URLs, credentials or identifiable project details. Ground a useful abstraction without inventing a rationale.

Review for connected sequences, explicit tradeoffs and conditions that change a choice. decision.kind is generic, sequence, tradeoff or conditional. Generic means a useful observable action without enough concrete choice structure for the overview; it is not a judgment about the person.

decision.condition has status stated (human explicitly says why/when), context (visible surrounding situation, not inferred motivation), or unknown. decision.alternative is observed only when human evidence explicitly describes a rejected, deferred or different choice; otherwise unknown. Both have text and refs; unknown has no refs. Never invent the obvious opposite to make a case interesting.

decision.steps contains zero to four connected human choices/planned actions, in visible order, each with text and human refs. Sequence requires at least two connected steps and a visible condition. Tradeoff and conditional require a human-stated condition and observed alternative. Do not confuse a sequence of unrelated chores with a coherent way of working.

Feature zero to three cases only after the project-independent specificity check. Retain the condition, division of work with AI, connected choices and observed alternative. A named tool, unusual task, complex implementation, ordinary correction or two-step chronology alone is not a distinctive use. Do not fill slots or certify uniqueness among people.

Before featuring, remove project-specific nouns mentally: can a reader still explain what this person asked AI to do, what they kept or deferred, and under what condition? If only a virtue such as clarify goals, try first, or reduce scope remains, keep the scene unfeatured. If the choice needs unseen project context, mark the gap rather than inventing it. Write the review reason explaining the specific combination and why it survives this check; this is a semantic review, not a keyword score.

Look for counterexamples and different choices across the whole bounded sample before calling something a habit. Without evidence of a switch under different conditions, ask a question rather than asserting consistent use or a universal rule. Avoid featuring several versions of the same correction.

Keep the existing classifiers, dates and share JSON unchanged. Cases are private. Only a user's explicit editing/saving action can create a separate text for sharing. Validators check structure and authorship, not the truth or confidentiality of prose.

Generate in three stages: (1) ground the concrete scene and decision; (2) independently write collaboration.pattern and collaboration.boundary from those human choices; (3) hide the scene and review title plus collaboration alone for portability. Do not fill the new fields by copying human_action or replacing technical nouns mechanically.

collaboration is null when no grounded abstraction is available, otherwise {pattern:{text,refs},boundary:{text,refs}}. Each claim is at most 240 characters and cites human messages already used in human_action or decision. pattern explains what the person asks AI to work out and how they proceed; boundary explains what the person keeps fixed, leaves open or changes under the observed condition. Do not invent motives, alternatives or success. Retain scene-specific operations in situation, human_action, ai_role and decision, not in the opening account.

Title and collaboration must describe the human-AI working relationship, not the product solution. A reader in another field should understand what is delegated, what remains a human decision and when the choice changes, without learning the product architecture. Test with an unrelated hypothetical setting privately; this is a test of intelligibility, not evidence that the person used it elsewhere or that it works there. Preserve the scope of this observed scene.

Record portability as portable, scene_bound, generic or unsupported in every review. Explain in reason which choice combination survives without scene knowledge, or why it fails. Only portable cases with a non-generic decision and separate collaboration claims can be featured. Zero to three is a ceiling, never a target. A semantic pass is an agent judgment, not a validator-certified quality score.

After writing the opening account, compare every clause with the scene evidence: do not turn a request into completion, context into a stated motive, a single scene into a habit, or an AI report into verified success. Write question about an unresolved boundary in this collaboration and try_next as an adaptable hypothetical request, without requiring the original product. If the abstraction loses the evidenced constraint, revise it or keep the case unfeatured.
